comment_scope_target.name: comment_scope_target
comment_scope_target.value: ("comments"."scopeType" = 'project' and num_nonnulls("comments"."taskId", "comments"."moduleId", "comments"."featureId") = 0) or ("comments"."scopeType" = 'task' and "comments"."taskId" is not null and num_nonnulls("comments"."taskId", "comments"."moduleId", "comments"."featureId") = 1) or ("comments"."scopeType" = 'module' and "comments"."moduleId" is not null and num_nonnulls("comments"."taskId", "comments"."moduleId", "comments"."featureId") = 1) or ("comments"."scopeType" = 'feature' and "comments"."featureId" is not null and num_nonnulls("comments"."taskId", "comments"."moduleId", "comments"."featureId") = 1)

diagram_scope_target.name: diagram_scope_target
diagram_scope_target.value: ("diagrams"."scopeType" = 'project' and num_nonnulls("diagrams"."taskId", "diagrams"."moduleId", "diagrams"."featureId") = 0) or ("diagrams"."scopeType" = 'task' and "diagrams"."taskId" is not null and num_nonnulls("diagrams"."taskId", "diagrams"."moduleId", "diagrams"."featureId") = 1) or ("diagrams"."scopeType" = 'module' and "diagrams"."moduleId" is not null and num_nonnulls("diagrams"."taskId", "diagrams"."moduleId", "diagrams"."featureId") = 1) or ("diagrams"."scopeType" = 'feature' and "diagrams"."featureId" is not null and num_nonnulls("diagrams"."taskId", "diagrams"."moduleId", "diagrams"."featureId") = 1)

document_scope_target.name: document_scope_target
document_scope_target.value: ("documents"."scopeType" = 'project' and num_nonnulls("documents"."taskId", "documents"."moduleId", "documents"."featureId") = 0) or ("documents"."scopeType" = 'task' and "documents"."taskId" is not null and num_nonnulls("documents"."taskId", "documents"."moduleId", "documents"."featureId") = 1) or ("documents"."scopeType" = 'module' and "documents"."moduleId" is not null and num_nonnulls("documents"."taskId", "documents"."moduleId", "documents"."featureId") = 1) or ("documents"."scopeType" = 'feature' and "documents"."featureId" is not null and num_nonnulls("documents"."taskId", "documents"."moduleId", "documents"."featureId") = 1)

file_scope_target.name: file_scope_target
file_scope_target.value: coalesce((("files"."scopeType" is null and num_nonnulls("files"."taskId", "files"."moduleId", "files"."featureId") = 0) or ("files"."scopeType" = 'project' and num_nonnulls("files"."taskId", "files"."moduleId", "files"."featureId") = 0) or ("files"."scopeType" = 'task' and "files"."taskId" is not null and num_nonnulls("files"."taskId", "files"."moduleId", "files"."featureId") = 1) or ("files"."scopeType" = 'module' and "files"."moduleId" is not null and num_nonnulls("files"."taskId", "files"."moduleId", "files"."featureId") = 1) or ("files"."scopeType" = 'feature' and "files"."featureId" is not null and num_nonnulls("files"."taskId", "files"."moduleId", "files"."featureId") = 1)), false)

notification_delivery_target.name: notification_delivery_target
notification_delivery_target.value: ("notification_deliveries"."invitationId" is not null and "notification_deliveries"."transport" = 'email' and num_nonnulls("notification_deliveries"."recipientId", "notification_deliveries"."notificationId", "notification_deliveries"."subscriptionId") = 0) or ("notification_deliveries"."invitationId" is null and "notification_deliveries"."recipientId" is not null and ("notification_deliveries"."transport" = 'ably' or ("notification_deliveries"."notificationId" is not null and ("notification_deliveries"."transport" = 'email' or ("notification_deliveries"."transport" = 'push' and "notification_deliveries"."subscriptionId" is not null)))))

notification_scope_target.name: notification_scope_target
notification_scope_target.value: ("notifications"."scopeType" = 'account' and num_nonnulls("notifications"."taskId", "notifications"."moduleId", "notifications"."featureId") = 0) or ("notifications"."projectId" is not null and (("notifications"."scopeType" = 'project' and num_nonnulls("notifications"."taskId", "notifications"."moduleId", "notifications"."featureId") = 0) or ("notifications"."scopeType" = 'task' and "notifications"."taskId" is not null and num_nonnulls("notifications"."taskId", "notifications"."moduleId", "notifications"."featureId") = 1) or ("notifications"."scopeType" = 'module' and "notifications"."moduleId" is not null and num_nonnulls("notifications"."taskId", "notifications"."moduleId", "notifications"."featureId") = 1) or ("notifications"."scopeType" = 'feature' and "notifications"."featureId" is not null and num_nonnulls("notifications"."taskId", "notifications"."moduleId", "notifications"."featureId") = 1)))

notification_source.name: notification_source
notification_source.value: num_nonnulls("notifications"."commentId", "notifications"."documentId") <= 1 and (("notifications"."scopeType" = 'account' and "notifications"."type" in ('project_access_granted', 'project_access_removed', 'invitation_accepted') and num_nonnulls("notifications"."commentId", "notifications"."documentId") = 0 and "notifications"."offsetMinutes" is null and ("notifications"."type" = 'invitation_accepted' or "notifications"."projectId" is not null)) or ("notifications"."scopeType" <> 'account' and ("notifications"."type" = 'mention' or ("notifications"."type" in ('assigned', 'shared', 'reminder') and "notifications"."scopeType" = 'task' and num_nonnulls("notifications"."commentId", "notifications"."documentId") = 0))))

due_time.name: due_time
due_time.value: "tasks"."dueTime" is null or ("tasks"."dueDate" is not null and "tasks"."dueTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

start_time.name: start_time
start_time.value: "tasks"."startTime" is null or ("tasks"."startDate" is not null and "tasks"."startTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
